Shell(pbcopy <<'EOF' You are doing the Blender art track for the Unity headset app (Track C, U6 assets), in parallel with another agent who is doing Track A (multiplayer removal) on the web/server code. Do not touch anything under `src/server/`, `src/shared/`, `src/client/`, or `docs/single-owner.md` — that's the other agent's lane. ## Read first 1. `gun-spec.md` — the .44 Magnum and the shoot/revive/medic behavior. You are authoring the 3D props it describes (gun mesh, medics, stretcher), not its TS code. 2. `docs/medic-sequence.md` — the medic pickup sequence: two white-uniform paramedics, stretcher, ~4.8s load, carry to elevator. Model what this sequence needs. 3. `docs/unity-headset.md` — sections 6.2 (art sources), 7.4 (gun and revival), 14 (performance budgets), 18 (U6 scope), 21 (repository layout: art under `native/unity/Assets/Art/`, Git LFS). 4. `tools/props/generate.py` and `tools/props/verify.mjs` — the existing Blender prop pipeline. Props are modelled in metres (a desk is 2.2 x 1.1 x 0.78), one Principled BSDF material, decimated under a per-prop triangle budget, exported to `src/client/public/props/<name>.glb` with a manifest carrying triangle count and bounds. ## Do 1. Use the Blender MCP tools (mcp__blender__*) to drive Blender directly — model in the live session with `mcp__blender__execute_blender_code`, check your work with `mcp__blender__get_viewport_screenshot` and `mcp__blender__get_scene_info`. 2. Extend `tools/props/generate.py` with builders for: - `magnum-44` — realistic silver .44 Magnum, right-hand grip scale. - `medic` — paramedic in white uniform, walking-carry pose; note any animation variants needed. - `stretcher` — with handles, sized so two medics carrying it reads correctly. 3. Keep each prop under its triangle budget (set budgets consistent with the existing manifest), model in metres, one Principled BSDF per prop. 4. Run `blender --background --python tools/props/generate.py -- magnum-44 medic stretcher` to export, then `node tools/props/verify.mjs` and make it pass. 5. Pass only your new prop names so every existing prop stays byte-identical. 6. Write a short `docs/props-art.md`: the new props, triangle counts, bounds, and open animation needs (medic walk/load/carry, gun draw/holster/recoil) for Unity milestone U6. ## Constraints - No changes to web client TS, server, shared code, tests, or `package.json`. - Export Unity-ready GLBs under `native/unity/Assets/Art/**` (Git LFS) per the Unity plan; the generator's canonical output path stays as the pipeline defines it. - Report at the end: files added/changed, `verify.mjs` output, triangle counts and bounds per prop, and anything deferred (rigs, animations). EOF echo "copied: $(pbpaste | wc -l) lines")
